project_type: pnpm monorepo with edge (Cloudflare Workers), frontend (React + Vite), backend (Python/FastAPI)
build_system: pnpm workspaces. Root at /projects/sandbox/-kalukaliya, packages in apps/*
test_framework: vitest for edge (v1.x) and frontend (v4.x), pytest for backend
build_command: pnpm --recursive run build (or per-workspace: pnpm --filter syrabit-edge run build)
test_command: Backend: cd apps/backend && python -m pytest; Edge: cd apps/edge && pnpm test; Frontend: cd apps/frontend && pnpm test
verification_instructions: 1. pnpm install from root to install all workspace deps. 2. Run edge tests: cd apps/edge && npx vitest run. 3. Run frontend tests: cd apps/frontend && npx vitest run. 4. Run backend tests: cd apps/backend && python -m pytest. All must pass.
setup_instructions: 1. cd /projects/sandbox/-kalukaliya && pnpm install (installs all workspace deps). 2. Backend already has venv set up at apps/backend.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode - can install all packages. Node 22 via nvm, Python 3.11 via pyenv. pnpm@10.26.1 available.
contribution_requirements: No specific CONTRIBUTING.md rules apply here. Tests should pass without external API access.
key_patterns: Edge tests use vitest with globals:true, mock Env interface with KVNamespace/R2Bucket stubs, vi.stubGlobal for fetch. Frontend tests use jsdom environment, @testing-library/react, setup.js extends jest-dom matchers. Frontend post-deploy-lighthouse test uses vi.resetModules + dynamic import pattern for main() integration tests.
directory_structure: Root monorepo with pnpm-workspace.yaml pointing to apps/*. apps/edge is a Cloudflare Worker (src/index.ts entry, middleware/ and routes/ dirs). apps/frontend is a React+Vite SPA with scripts/, src/__tests__/ and src/test/ for tests. apps/backend is a Python FastAPI app.
